releases.name: Jesus Simulator
releases.summary: Jesus Simulator is a narrative driven game that retells the earthly life of Jesus Christ through the events of the Gospel. Become a witness to sermons, miracles, and encounters that explore love, mercy, faith, forgiveness, and sacrifice.

releases.name: John Fox
releases.summary:
John Fox is an elite warrior and super soldier who saved the leaders of various States. He was a professional mercenary who retired with honor. But now his beloved pet, Milo, has been killed. 

You have to avenge him!

releases.name: Grizzy & the Lemmings: Crazy Party
releases.summary: Grizzy and the Lemmings - Crazy Party is a family-focused party game for one to four players who can choose from 40 different lemming characters to play. The Lemmings compete across 50 zany mini-games, six game modes and five boards, inspired by the series, in a mad race to grab as much Yummy as possible right under Grizzy's nose - and he's not about to let them get away with it!

releases.name: Kitties Solitaire
releases.summary:
340 levels of cozy, cuddly card fun.

Curl up with the coziest card game on your console! Kitties Solitaire wraps the classic TriPeaks Solitaire experience in an adorable world of playful cats, warm colors, and charming feline companions.
Clear the peaks one card at a time in this relaxing yet endlessly engaging solitaire adventure. With 340 handcrafted levels, every session brings a fresh challenge — and a new reason to keep those paws tapping.
Features:

Full TriPeaks Solitaire — Master the beloved card system that's easy to learn and satisfying to perfect.
340 Levels — A massive collection designed to keep you playing for hours on end.
Unique Card Layouts — Varied and creative board designs ensure no two levels feel the same, delivering long-term engagement.
Smooth & Responsive — Enjoy fluid animations and tight controls that make every move feel great.
Undo & Rewards — Rethink your strategy with the handy undo system, and collect rewards as you climb each peak.

Whether you're a solitaire veteran or just love cute cats, Kitties Solitaire is the purr-fect way to unwind. Deal yourself in and let the good times paw-r in!

releases.name: Sandbox Doodle Playground
releases.summary:
Build. Craft. Destroy. Create Your Own Playground. Experiment Without Limits.

Sandbox Doodle Playground, a creative physics sandbox where your imagination becomes reality! Craft, build, experiment, and create endless scenarios using a huge collection of characters, weapons, vehicles, tools, and interactive objects.
Design your own worlds, build incredible machines, or unleash total chaos with realistic ragdoll physics. Every object reacts naturally, allowing you to create funny experiments, epic battles, crazy chain reactions, or peaceful constructions. There are no rules or missions—only unlimited freedom to play your way.
Whether you enjoy engineering complex contraptions, testing physics, or simply creating hilarious moments, Sandbox Doodle Playground gives you all the tools you need.

Features:
Creative physics sandbox with realistic interactions.
Draw and build your own unique playground.
Hundreds of objects, weapons, vehicles, and tools.
Realistic ragdoll physics and destructible environments.
Create machines, traps, battles, and chain reactions.
Endless possibilities with no limits or objectives.
Easy-to-use controls for players of all ages.

releases.name: Prison Escape Simulator 2026
releases.summary:
Can you dig a secret tunnel before the guards discover your plan?

Dig Your Way to Freedom

Trapped behind bars, you have only one chance to escape: dig a secret tunnel beneath your prison cell and reach freedom before the guards discover your plan.

Every day is a careful balancing act. Dig deeper into the ground, hide the tunnel entrance under your cell's carpet, and keep an eye on guard patrols. One mistake is all it takes to get caught, lose progress, and start over.

As you excavate the tunnel, you'll uncover valuable items buried underground. Trade them with the prison cook for soap—the prison's underground currency—and invest in powerful upgrades. Buy better tools to dig faster, increase your carrying capacity, and expand your pockets to secretly transport more dirt.

Managing the excavated soil is just as important as digging. Sneak outside and dispose of it before anyone becomes suspicious. The deeper your tunnel grows, the more careful you'll need to be.

releases.name: Task Force Ranger - Breakpoint
releases.summary:
Task Force Ranger: Breakpoint is a modern military shooter focused on intense combat and high-risk special operations.

Deploy as Bravo Team in the conflict zone of Al-Shamal and carry out a series of dangerous missions against the Jazeera Front. Recover critical intelligence, destroy enemy infrastructure, eliminate hostile leadership, and cripple their ability to operate across the region.

Fight through fortified compounds, industrial facilities, urban districts, and remote mountain strongholds. Expect heavy resistance, armored threats, and large-scale firefights as enemy forces attempt to stop your advance.

Use assault rifles, machine guns, sniper rifles, pistols, explosives, and support weapons to complete your objectives and survive overwhelming odds.

Beyond the campaign, test your skills in Survival Mode, where endless enemy waves push your combat abilities to the limit. Earn money, upgrade your equipment, and see how long you can hold the line.

releases.name: Limbot
releases.summary:
Welcome to Limbot, the ultimate physics-based city stomping experience where up to 4 players must attempt to pilot a person dressed as a giant cardboard robot! 

Embrace the chaos in a paper-craft metropolis designed to be crushed, smashed, and destroyed!

Intuitive controls make moving limbs simple and accessible to players of all ages and abilities. All you need to do is figure out how to work together... good luck with that! Oh, one more thing, if the robot trips, it's definitely your teammate’s fault!

releases.name: ROUTE-16R
releases.summary:
The ROUTE16 remake. Beat the revived Kanharoo Gang with your car MAD X-R!

ROUTE16R is a remake of the ROUTE16 series, originally released in the 1980s.

Avoid enemy vehicles and monsters as you race through the stage, collecting every item scattered across the maze.
Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate intricate labyrinths filled with traps and gimmicks, and Radar Mode, which reveals the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a high-speed chase experience that surpasses the original games.

Not Just Escape - Fight Back with the Evolved MAD X-R :
Unlike previous ROUTE16 titles, colliding with enemies triggers a transformation: MAD X-R shifts into a combat robot, initiating battle.
Use your upgraded MAD X-R’s attacks along with SP items collected throughout the stage to deal damage and defeat your enemies.

Customization :
Before entering a stage, use the money you’ve recovered to customize your MAD X-R.
Enhance core attributes like fuel and speed, as well as combat performance, to suit your playstyle.

Boss Battles :
The Kanharoo Gang won’t go down without a fight.
Collecting all items won’t end the stage-doing so will trigger a boss encounter.
Bosses unleash intense attacks to corner MAD X-R.

releases.name: Hex Park
releases.summary:
Welcome to Hex Park - a colorful playground of brainteasers where every move matters. Rotate and align arrow tiles to guide directions, pop obstacles, and clear the board in as few moves as possible. It’s easy to pick up, delightfully tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

Tackle 150 handcrafted levels featuring smart mechanics: keys and locks, mystery tiles, bombs, ice counters, gears, and more. Plan routes, set up neat arrow alignments, and use handy tools like the hammer, dynamite, and drill when you need a nudge. 

No timers, no stress - just clean, strategic puzzle-solving with that perfect “one more level” feel.

releases.name: Forgotten Vault
releases.summary:
Enter a forgotten underground vault in this fast-paced pixel-art roguelike shooter. Explore procedurally generated dungeons, collect powerful weapons, battle dangerous enemies.

Descend into a forgotten underground vault where every room hides new dangers, valuable supplies, and terrifying enemies.

Fight your way through five increasingly difficult dungeon levels in a fast-paced, top-down pixel-art roguelike shooter. Each run features procedurally generated rooms, unpredictable encounters, and randomized loot, ensuring that no two expeditions feel exactly the same.

Choose from three playable characters with different strengths, then search the vault for weapons, ammunition, health supplies, and other useful equipment. Expand your arsenal with pistols, shotguns, lasers, rockets, and other weapons, each offering different firing patterns, magazine sizes, and combat possibilities.

Stay mobile, dodge incoming attacks, take cover behind interactive objects, and flip tables to block enemy projectiles. Break containers, open mysterious chests, explore cleared areas using the minimap, and prepare for powerful bosses waiting at the end of every level.

The deeper you travel, the more dangerous the vault becomes. Enemies grow faster, attack more frequently, and appear in greater numbers. Taking damage can also affect your sanity, briefly distorting the world around you and making every battle even more unsettling.

releases.name: Jelly Math
releases.summary:
Get ready for a sweet, clever and surprising puzzle where numbers and jellies come together in the most fun way possible. In Jelly Math, each colorful piece has a unique value and shape, and it is up to you to combine them strategically to form the perfect equation.

Nothing here is just about placing pieces. Every move influences the final result, and small changes can completely transform your solution. Choose, rotate and place your jellies while testing combinations, adjusting operators and finding the exact balance to reach the goal.

With challenges that grow in a smooth and creative way, you will deal with new elements that make everything even more interesting, such as modifiers that multiply values and spaces that require careful planning. All of this in light and cozy picnic-themed environments.

Colorful, relaxing and at the same time challenging, Jelly Math is perfect for players who love puzzles that stimulate thinking and reward each discovery with that delicious feeling of getting it right.

Experiment, adjust and find the perfect result in every level.

releases.name: Street Racing Simulator EVO : Car & Moto
releases.summary:
Race Anything, Anytime, Anywhere.

Street Racing Simulator EVO : Car & Moto
Are you ready to take the wheel and experience the most realistic and exhilarating driving simulation on handheld? Street Racing EVO, developed by Ovilex, is here to redefine your expectations of car and motorcycle racing games. With its stunning visuals, immersive gameplay, and endless customization options, this game is a must-play for any driving enthusiast.

What Makes Street Racing Simulator EVO Stand Out?
Unmatched Realism and Highly Detailed Vehicles
Every car and motorcycle is crafted with precision, featuring intricate interiors and exteriors that bring your ride to life.
Interior POV
Step into the driver’s seat with a first-person interior view that offers an unparalleled level of immersion. Feel like you’re truly behind the wheel as you navigate through diverse environments.
Handcrafted Details
From the roar of the engine to the sound of tires gripping the road, every detail is designed to enhance your driving experience.
Dual Thrills: Cars & Motorcycles
Whether you’re a fan of high-performance sports cars or the agility of motorcycles, Street Racing EVO has it all. Race through challenging terrains on two wheels or dominate the streets in your customized dream car.
Endless Customization
Make your vehicle truly yours with a wide range of customization options. From paint jobs to engine upgrades, you can fine-tune every aspect of your ride to match your style and performance preferences.

releases.name: Blast Off! Summer Showdown
releases.summary: Blast off and let the chaos begin! A party game for up to 4 players featuring 10 summer-themed minigames, including rocket fireworks, flowing somen races, and BBQ battles!

releases.name: Solitaire World - Anime Waifus
releases.summary:
A classical Solitaire game with a waifu twist. Play classic Solitaire in a exciting, anime-inspired world full of anime waifus.

This game combines timeless Solitaire gameplay with a peaceful anime presentation filled with soft colors and elegant designs.

Play classic Klondike Solitaire in 1-card or 3-card draw mode, focusing on clean moves, smart decisions, and a satisfying flow. Each completed game rewards you with score and experience, based on how efficiently you play.

As you gain experience, you level up and unlock cosmetic rewards. These include beautiful anime-style card skins, serene backgrounds inspired by cherry blossoms and temples, and stylish card backs. Every single card has multiple skins and can be customized individually.

Before each match, you can freely adjust your deck and table to match your mood. Whether you prefer soft pastel tones, detailed anime illustrations, or a more minimal look, every game feels personal and relaxing.

With no time pressure and a steady sense of progression, the game offers hours of soothing gameplay and a constantly growing collection of beautiful cards.

releases.name: Apocalypse ? No !
releases.summary: In Apocalypse ? No ! you play a survivor accompanied by his faithful dog in a world in ruins. Discover many varied maps: From a peaceful forest, through survivor camps to ruined cities, these maps are just waiting to be explored.

releases.name: ROUTE-16 COLLECTION
releases.summary:
The classic car-chase maze series returns! 3 high-octane action games in one.

ROUTE16 COLLECTION includes ROUTE16R in addition to two classic titles from the 1980s ROUTE16 series.

The ROUTE16 series is a thrilling car chase action experience where you control your beloved car, MAD X, collecting all items while evading relentless enemy cars and monsters.

ROUTE16R:
The legendary ROUTE16 returns as a brand-new title!
This time, MAD X-R isn’t just about escaping-fight back with customization and transformation to defeat incoming enemies in high-speed chase action.

- Customize and transform into a robot! Intense battle system
Use the money collected in stages to freely customize MAD X-R. Upgrade fuel, speed, and combat performance before heading into battle.
Collide with enemies to transform into a powerful robot form and use enhanced stats and SP items to defeat both minor enemies and powerful bosses.

releases.name: Route-16 Turbo
releases.summary:
Control MAD X and take back the stolen money!

ROUTE16TURBO is an action game released in 1985.

Take control of your car, MAD X, and evade relentless enemy cars as you infiltrate the secret base of the evil Kanharoo Gang to recover all the stolen money.

Switch dynamically between Maze Mode, where you navigate complex labyrinths, and Radar Mode, which displays the entire stage made up of 16 mazes-delivering a constantly thrilling car chase experience.

This version also includes stages that were unreachable in the original 1985 release.
Now’s your chance to beat the high scores you set back then!

releases.name: Obakeidoro 2: Chase & Seek
releases.summary:
‘OBAKEIDORO 2: Chase & Seek’, is Japanese asymmetric multiplayer chase-and-seek game for up to 8 players. The game set this time is in old-Japan, with easy-to-understand rule of its predecessor, ‘OBAKEIDORO!’. 

The rule is simple. Each match lasts for only 3 minutes with simple control. The players play on either the Human team (3 players) or the Monster team (1 player). While the Human team must keep at least 1 Human out of jail to win, the Monster team must capture all Humans before the time runs out. They can, however, also strategize their thoughts using characters' skills and traits; these features allow everyone NOT to get bored!

releases.name: Aery - Surreal World
releases.summary:
Aery – Surreal World is a relaxing, story-driven flight exploration game that carries you through a series of impossible, dreamlike worlds where reality has quietly lost its mind. 

You play as a tiny spirit drifting endlessly forward through landscapes that shouldn't exist. Glide alongside an enormous dirty whale as it tumbles weightlessly through a sky laced with glittering rainbows — close enough to see the barnacles and grime clinging to its hide as streaks of violet and gold light wash over it. Descend into a sunken apartment block resting silently on the ocean floor, where coral has crept up the wallpaper, fish drift through the living room, and the television still flickers faintly in the deep blue dark. Soar through a vast kingdom where every tree, every cloud, and every cobblestone has been consumed by solid, gleaming gold — beautiful, eerie, and utterly silent. 

Each world is its own self-contained dream: a unique color palette, atmosphere, and mood that tells a different piece of a larger, quietly unfolding story. Hidden across every level are glowing memory fragments — scattered clues to what this broken universe once was. Collect enough of them and the next impossible world opens up.

Aery – Surreal World is designed above all else to feel good. The flying is smooth and freeing, the worlds are strange and beautiful, and the story unfolds gently without ever demanding anything of you. Whether you play to explore, to collect, or simply to get lost somewhere wonderfully weird, there is always something waiting just around the next impossible corner.

releases.name: Pool Party Girls: Splash Babes
releases.summary:
The pool's heating up and they're all watching you play. Nail the minigames, win their attention, unlock exclusive images.

Sun, water, and a group of anime girls cheering you on from the pool's edge. Every point you score, every combo you land, gets their eyes on you a little more. One summer party, zero excuses to stop playing.

Stack, match, and hold the line while they react to every move you make.

Each girl has her own energy, whether she's screaming "YOU GOT THIS" from the diving board or blushing every time you pull off something impressive.

Think you can unlock every girls before summer ends?

releases.name: Dark Witch Match!
releases.summary: The first-ever competitive puzzle game from the world of The Legend of Dark Witch! Match blocks, build chains, and overwhelm your rival in a Match-3 battler that's easy to learn but deep to master. Play cross-platform climb the global leaderboards, and dive into Story and Score Attack modes.
